description: This file defines a mapping profile for AutoMapper, configuring object-object mappings between Domain.Person and Profile classes within the Profiles feature of the Conduit project.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper.Profile that configures the mapping rules for Profile objects based on Domain.Person.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that sets up AutoMapper mapping from Domain.Person to Profile with no member list restrictions.
